tasks.title: Status adopts the merged contract 2.4.1 after its 2.4.0 prerequisite
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, R7 precondition and all Completion evidence; Rollout step 3; Security impact dependency pins; Acceptance evidence 5. Before editing, verify status main has the 2.4.0 contract c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb provided by #809. If it still pins an older commit (currently 9ab7e2492a2cec91789fba7c742bdba900a800a9), request a needs-input hold naming #809; if it already pins 2.4.1 or later, hold because the change is already there. Preserve the requested native blocked-by #809 rollout dependency. Once ready and contract has merged, bump only package.json and bun.lock to the full 2.4.1 main merge SHA shared by all consumers. No new tests or status behavior changes are required.

acceptance.expected: Before implementation, @lorenzh/pulse-contract pins c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb from #809. An older pin triggers a needs-input hold naming #809; 2.4.1 or later triggers a hold because the change is already present.
exit 0; the updated dependency pin and lockfile agree.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with the existing 80% line coverage gate.

package.json and bun.lock's workspace dependency contain the same full 40-character SHA of the merged pulse-contract main commit implementing R1-R6 (version 2.4.1), independently verified from that contract PR; the lockfile resolution matches that commit.
Before committing, exactly package.json and bun.lock are changed; no test or source changes.
exit 0; required status CI checks, including the existing a11y checks, pass on the new dependency.

Records that #809's 2.4.0 prerequisite was satisfied, the independently verified 2.4.1 main merge SHA and matching lockfile, bun run check and CI results, two-file-only scope and applicable Security impact dependency-pin review.
